Hyperliquid Recovery Bot: Flagged Address Solution
Hyperliquid Recovery Bot is a Telegram assistant that helps users recover assets from flagged or restricted Hyperliquid addresses.





💡 Need immediate help? Jump directly to Recovery Instructions to start rescuing your assets.

Product Positioning
This tool is a dedicated Telegram recovery assistant for users whose address can connect in the frontend but cannot operate assets due to high-risk restrictions.
Typical frontend warning in this scenario:

Action blocked: Address flagged for suspicious activity. Your address has been flagged as high risk by a third-party screening tool. This frontend interface does not support connection to the Hyperliquid blockchain by high risk addresses.

In this scenario, the frontend typically shows a red warning overlay and disables or restricts common operation buttons. The bot helps you check what can be handled now, guides you through recovery, and sends funds back to the same address on Arbitrum.
Who Should Use This

You can access the private key or mnemonic for the address but typically cannot fully operate it in the Hyperliquid frontend.
You want a guided recovery flow instead of handling everything manually.
You need clear fee disclosure before executing the emergency withdrawal.

What You Get

Full account detection across spot assets, perpetual positions, vault assets, and staked assets.
A guided multi-step recovery flow with real-time progress.
Unified fee presentation: Service Fee, Withdrawal Fees, Total Cost, You Will Receive.
On-chain verifiability with transaction hashes.

Recovery Scope

Spot assets: non-USDC assets are sold to USDC.
Perpetual positions: eligible positions are closed as part of recovery.
Vault assets: assets that can be withdrawn now are handled first; temporarily unavailable assets are left for a later run.
Staked assets: the bot handles staking-related balances step by step and tells you when to run again if waiting is required.

Security Principles

Use only the official bot entry.
Never provide your private key or mnemonic to any person, group, form, or website outside the bot's official recovery flow.
Use transaction hashes and on-chain results to verify what was completed.

Fee Principles

Service Fee: 0.5% of recovered value, minimum 1 USDC.
Withdrawal Fees: 2 USDC total (two Hyperliquid withdrawals, 1 USDC each).
Total Cost: Service Fee + Withdrawal Fees.
You Will Receive: Estimated Recoverable Value - Total Cost.

Start Here

Open bot: https://t.me/HyperliquidRecoveryBot
Read Quick Start
Review Asset Recovery
Check Fee and Settlement
Review Security and Privacy

Operational Notes

Final withdrawal goes to the Arbitrum address corresponding to the source address (same address).
Settlement is not always instant after withdrawal submission. Arrival time depends on Hyperliquid processing and may take several to more than ten minutes.
Result pages may show: completed, partial, waiting_to_rerun, or failed.
partial means some assets were handled, but more work may still be needed.
waiting_to_rerun means the bot needs you to come back later after a waiting period ends.
If nothing could be handled yet, the result will not be shown as completed.

Need Help

Read FAQ

asset-recovery.html.title: Asset Recovery
asset-recovery.html.body:
Hyperliquid Asset Extraction: Emergency Withdrawal Workflow
The Asset Recovery pipeline provides an automated safeguard to extract stuck funds from a flagged Hyperliquid address and execute an emergency withdrawal to your Arbitrum wallet.
Inputs Required
Prepare the following before execution:

Source address (flagged address)
Private key or mnemonic (signing only)

Standard 7-Step Pipeline
The bot generates and executes steps based on detected assets. Ineligible steps are skipped automatically.

Check account status
Convert spot assets (non-USDC -> USDC)
Close or convert perpetual positions as needed
Withdraw vault assets that are currently available
Handle staking and withdrawable balance
Collect service fee
Complete final withdrawal

Step Behavior
1) Account Preparation, Spot, and Perp

Account status: if account setup requires adjustment before recovery, the bot handles that first.
Spot: sells non-USDC assets into USDC.
Perp: handles eligible positions and closes or converts them as needed for recovery.

2) Vault

Currently withdrawable assets: withdrawn in current run.
Locked assets or vault equity with no current withdrawable amount: shown as waiting/locked in preview and results, then retried after unlock or withdrawability returns.

3) Staking (Important)
The bot distinguishes between already-unstaked balance, still-staked balance, and pending-withdrawal balance.
Two practical paths may occur:

Faster path (2 runs): if some staking balance is already ready for the next stage, part of it can be withdrawn in the first run and the rest follows after the waiting period.
Standard path (3 runs): if the balance is still fully staked, recovery usually needs an unstake stage and then a later withdrawal stage.

The bot output always includes rerun guidance based on current state.
Fees and Settlement

Service Fee: 0.5%, minimum 1 USDC
Withdrawal Fees: 2 USDC
Total Cost: Service Fee + Withdrawal Fees
You Will Receive: Estimated Recoverable Value - Total Cost

See Fee and Settlement for formulas and examples.
How to Read Results
Execution output includes step-level status and final summary:

Recovered Amount
Actual Fees
Transaction hashes for on-chain verification

Note: after withdrawal submission, settlement to Arbitrum is asynchronous and depends on Hyperliquid processing speed (often several to more than ten minutes).
Status mapping is documented in Execution Status.
If the result page says more waiting is required, follow the suggested rerun time.
Retry Strategy

Network issue: rerun directly.
Lock or waiting state: rerun at suggested time.
Input mismatch (address/key): fix inputs and rerun.

Best Practices

Run address detection before recovery to confirm asset structure.
No destination input is required; withdrawal defaults to the source address on Arbitrum.
For staking or locked vault cases, set reminders and rerun at unlock windows.

execution-status.html.title: Execution Status
execution-status.html.body:
Execution Status
The recovery system uses two layers of status: step-level statuses describe each operation, while task-level outcomes explain how to understand the entire recovery run and what to do next.
Task-Level Outcomes



Outcome
Meaning
Recommended Action




completed
This run produced actual progress or recovered funds, and no immediate rerun is needed
No immediate rerun needed


partial
This run only partially progressed, or recovered nothing while assets still remain blocked/waiting
Review the summary and follow up as needed


waiting_to_rerun
This run progressed successfully, but protocol waiting or lock windows remain
Rerun after the waiting window ends


failed
This run was interrupted by a fatal error
Fix the root cause before retrying



Step-Level Statuses
Status Matrix



Status
Icon
Meaning
Recommended Action




completed
✅
Step fully completed
Wait for next steps


completed_partial
⚠️
Partial success, some assets skipped or failed
Review notes and rerun if needed


completed_waiting
⏰
Operation succeeded but protocol waiting period applies
Rerun at suggested time


skipped_locked
🔒
Assets currently locked
Wait for unlock and rerun


skipped_no_assets
➖
No eligible assets for this step
No action required


failed_system_error
❌
System-level failure
Retry later or contact support


failed_user_error
⛔
Input or configuration issue
Fix input and retry


failed_network_error
🌐❌
Network or RPC issue
Check network and retry



Typical Interpretations

⚠️ completed_partial: common when only part of vault/staking assets are currently executable.
⏰ completed_waiting: common in staking, where execution succeeds but unlock windows remain (for example, 1-day or 7-day waiting periods).
🔒 skipped_locked: not a hard failure; it indicates protocol lock state.
If the whole run is only skipped_* and no funds are actually recovered, the task-level outcome becomes partial, not completed.

When to Rerun Recovery

If the task-level outcome is waiting_to_rerun, rerun after the suggested unlock time.
If the task-level outcome is completed, no immediate extra action is usually required.
If the task-level outcome is partial, review the remaining issues before deciding whether to rerun now.
If step outputs include failed_* and the task-level outcome is failed, resolve the root cause first, then rerun.

This page explains how to use the bot more safely and what you can verify yourself.
Safe Use Basics

Never provide your private key or mnemonic to any person, group, form, or website outside the bot's official recovery flow.

If some assets are still waiting or locked, come back and run recovery again after the required time.

glossary.html.title: Glossary
glossary.html.body:
Glossary
This page explains the common words you may see during detection and recovery.
Fee Terms

Service Fee: 0.5% of recovered value, minimum 1 USDC.
Withdrawal Fees: Hyperliquid withdrawal fee, usually 2 USDC total.
Total Cost: Service Fee + Withdrawal Fees.
You Will Receive: estimated/actual user settlement amount.

Accounts and Assets

SPOT: regular token balances in your spot account.
PERP: perpetual positions or balances related to perpetual trading.
VAULT: assets held in vaults; some may be temporarily locked.
STAKED: HYPE balances that are in a staking-related state.

Staking States

HYPE-STAKED: HYPE is still actively staked and cannot be withdrawn immediately.
HYPE-UNSTAKED: HYPE has left active staking and is ready for a later step.
HYPE-PENDING: withdrawal has been initiated and is still in the waiting period.

Step-Level Statuses

completed: this step finished successfully.
completed_partial: this step finished only in part; some assets may still need follow-up.
completed_waiting: this step finished, but you must wait before the next action.
skipped_locked: this step was skipped because the asset is currently locked.
skipped_no_assets: this step was skipped because there was nothing eligible to process.
failed_*: this step failed because of a system, input, or network issue.

Task-Level Outcomes

completed: this run made real progress or recovered funds, and you do not need to rerun it right now.
partial: this run only finished in part, or nothing was recovered yet while some assets are still blocked or waiting.
waiting_to_rerun: this run progressed correctly, but you still need to wait and run it again later.
failed: this run stopped because of a fatal error.

faq.html.title: FAQ
faq.html.body:
Hyperliquid Recovery FAQ: Flagged Address Troubleshooting
This troubleshooting guide provides technical solutions for extracting assets from a flagged Hyperliquid address or restricted account.
🤖 Bot Basic Questions
Q: What is Hyperliquid Recovery Bot?
A: Hyperliquid Recovery Bot is a professional Telegram bot designed specifically for Hyperliquid ecosystem users to help users safely recover digital assets from addresses flagged as high-risk.
Q: Is the bot free to use?
A: Address detection is completely FREE. Asset recovery services charge:

Service Fee: 0.5% of total asset value (minimum 1 USDC)
Withdrawal Fees: 2 USDC (Hyperliquid platform)
Example: Recover $1,000 → Pay $7 → Get $993

Q: How to confirm this is the official bot?
A: Please ensure you access the bot using the official link:

Official Address: https://t.me/HyperliquidRecoveryBot
Username: @HyperliquidRecoveryBot
Verification: Check the bot's function menu and interface features

Q: What languages does the bot support?
A: Currently supports:

Chinese: Complete Simplified Chinese support
English: Full English language support

Q: What are the bot's operating hours?
A: The bot runs continuously and can be used at any time. However, it is recommended to perform important operations when network conditions are good.
🔍 Address Detection Questions
Q: What address formats are supported?
A: Supports standard Hyperliquid address formats:

Length: 42 characters (including 0x prefix)
Format: 0x + 40 hexadecimal characters
Example: 0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890

Q: How long does detection take?
A: Usually completed within a few seconds to a few minutes, depending on:

Network conditions
Hyperliquid API response speed
Number and complexity of assets in the address

Q: Is the detected asset information accurate?
A: Yes, the bot uses Hyperliquid official API to get real-time data, which is accurate and reliable. However, please note:

Price information may have 1-2 minutes delay
Some new tokens may temporarily have no price information
Network congestion may affect data updates

Q: Why do some assets not display prices?
A: Possible reasons:

Newly listed tokens have no price data yet
Low liquidity tokens
Price API temporarily unavailable
Token has been delisted or stopped trading

Q: Can multiple addresses be detected?
A: Each detection run currently processes one address. You can repeat detection for different addresses.
Q: How long is detection history saved?
A: This public guide does not treat detection history as a long-term record. Please use the current result page as your main reference.
🛠️ Asset Recovery Questions
Q: What asset types can be recovered?
A: The bot can recover 4 types of assets:

✅ Spot Assets: USDC, ETH, BTC, and other tokens
✅ Perpetual Contracts: Long/short positions
✅ Vault Assets: Assets deposited in vaults (if not locked)
✅ Staked Assets: HYPE tokens staked to validators (requires waiting period)

Q: When is asset recovery needed?
A: When your address is flagged as high-risk and:

The frontend can connect the address, but typically you are unable to perform Hyperliquid L1 native asset operations (like transfers, trades, or withdrawals).
The frontend may show a warning overlay with system responses such as:

Action blocked: Address flagged for suspicious activity. Your address has been flagged as high risk by a third-party screening tool. This frontend interface does not support connection to the Hyperliquid blockchain by high risk addresses.


A red warning overlay appears and operation buttons are disabled.
Cannot perform normal trading operations.
Assets may be restricted in frontend operations.

Q: How long does the recovery process take?
A: Spot and perpetual assets are usually recovered quickly. For staked assets, recovery usually takes 2-3 runs depending on current state:

Optimized path (2 runs): when undelegated balance already exists
Standard path (3 runs): when only delegated balance exists (typically 1 day + 7 days windows)

Q: Can the recovery process be cancelled?
A: Once confirmed to start recovery operation, it cannot be cancelled. Therefore, please carefully check all information before confirmation.
Q: Is the private key secure?
A: Follow these basic rules:

Enter credentials only in the bot's official recovery flow
Never send private keys or mnemonics to any person, group, form, or external website
Do not screenshot, forward, or paste credentials into chat windows
If you cannot confirm the bot entry is official, stop and verify first

Q: What if I have staked HYPE tokens?
A: The bot handles staking states automatically and tells you when to rerun:

It may complete in 2 runs if part of the balance is already ready for the next stage
Or require 3 runs if the balance must first pass through the full unstake waiting flow

Q: What if my vault assets are locked?
A: The bot will skip locked vault assets:

Wait for the lock period to end
Then run recovery again to withdraw them

Q: Can I specify withdrawal to a specific address?
A: No. Recovery does not require destination input. Funds are withdrawn to the Arbitrum address corresponding to the source address.
Q: What to do if recovery fails?
A: First check which task-level outcome appears on the result page:

failed: this run was interrupted by a fatal error; review the cause before retrying
partial: this run recovered some assets, but remaining assets still need attention
waiting_to_rerun: this run progressed correctly, but you must wait for protocol windows to end before the next run

If the final outcome is truly failed, the bot will automatically retry on network failures. If it continues to fail:

Check your internet connection
Verify private key is correct
Check error message
Contact support if needed

💰 Fee Related Questions
Q: How much does recovery cost?
A: Total cost = Service Fee + Withdrawal Fees

Service Fee: 0.5% of total asset value (minimum 1 USDC)
Withdrawal Fees: 2 USDC (Hyperliquid platform charges)

Examples:
| Your Assets | Service Fee | Withdrawal Fees | Total Cost | You Receive |
|-------------|-------------|-----------------|------------|-------------|
| $100 | $1 | $2 | $3 | $97 |
| $1,000 | $5 | $2 | $7 | $993 |
| $10,000 | $50 | $2 | $52 | $9,948 |
Q: What does the service fee include?
A: Service fee includes:

All asset conversions (ETH, BTC, etc. → USDC)
All account transfers (Spot → Perpetual)
Recovery orchestration and execution service
Technical support

Note: Hyperliquid withdrawal fees are billed separately under Withdrawal Fees.
Q: When is the service fee charged?
A: Service fee is processed during the service-fee collection stage in the recovery pipeline. If execution does not reach fee collection, no service fee is charged.
Q: Why are there withdrawal fees?
A: Hyperliquid platform charges 1 USDC per withdrawal. The bot makes 2 withdrawals:

First withdrawal: Collect service fee (1 USDC)
Second withdrawal: Send your assets (1 USDC)
Total: 2 USDC withdrawal fees

🔒 Security Related Questions
Q: How to ensure operation security?
A: Please follow these security recommendations:

Operate in secure devices and network environments
Do not enter private keys in public places
Carefully verify each operation step
If you use a shared device, log out and close related chats after use

Q: Will private keys be saved?
A: This user guide focuses on what you should do as a user: only enter credentials in the bot's official recovery flow, never provide them to any person or external page, and verify results with transaction hashes and on-chain records.
Q: How to prevent fraud?
A: Please note:

Only use the official bot @HyperliquidRecoveryBot
Do not enter private keys elsewhere
Outside the bot's official recovery flow, no support staff, private chat, or group will ask for your private key or mnemonic
Be wary of false promises and unreasonable profit guarantees

Q: What to do if suspicious activity is found?
A: If any suspicious activity is found:

Stop operation immediately
Screenshot and save evidence (excluding sensitive information)

🔧 Technical Questions
Q: Why does address validation fail?
A: Possible reasons:

Incorrect address format (missing 0x prefix or wrong length)
Contains invalid characters
Extra spaces or characters included during copy-paste
Not a valid Hyperliquid (EVM) address format

Q: Why does private key validation fail?
A: Possible reasons:

Private key format does not match current input requirements (including optional prefix/length mismatch)
Incorrect private key length (should be 64 hexadecimal characters)
Private key does not match address
Extra characters included during input

Q: How to handle network errors?
A: When encountering network errors:

Check if network connection is stable
Try switching to a more stable network
Wait a few minutes and retry

Q: What to do if API calls fail?
A: API call failures may be due to:

Hyperliquid API temporarily unavailable
Network connection issues
Request frequency too high
Recommend retrying later

📱 User Experience Questions
Q: Can it be used on mobile phones?
A: Yes, the bot fully supports mobile use. Recommendations:

Use the latest version of Telegram app
Ensure stable mobile network connection
Operate in secure environment

Q: What to do if interface display is abnormal?
A: If interface display is abnormal:

Try restarting Telegram app
Send /start command to reinitialize
Check if Telegram app is the latest version

Q: What to do if operation response is slow?
A: Slow operation response may be due to:

Unstable network connection
High Telegram server load
Slow Hyperliquid API response
Recommend operating when network conditions are good

🆘 Emergency Situations
Q: What to do if errors occur during recovery process?
A: If errors occur during recovery process:

Don't panic, record error information
Check if network connection is normal
Check whether the result page shows partial or waiting_to_rerun, since these do not always mean the run failed

Q: What to do if assets don't arrive on Arbitrum?
A: If assets do not arrive on the source address on Arbitrum:

Check transaction hash status in blockchain explorer
Confirm the source address is correct and can receive on Arbitrum
Wait for Hyperliquid processing and additional confirmations (arrival may take several to more than ten minutes)
